none: PAS FindID 984353: Roman Coin: Nummus of the House of Constantine
contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy coin. Probably a nummus of the House of Constantine (306-361); if so, probably a Soli Invicto issue of 310-319, Reece period 15. Obverse description: Bust possibly diademed right. Reverse description: Sol standing left with arms outstretched, ?holding globe. Reverse inscription: [SOLI INVICTO COMITI]. Diameter: 20.2mm, Weight: 2.05gms, die axis: 6
